title: Company Approvals and Pay on Account: Sell to Businesses | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Businesses rarely pay at the till: they buy on account, quote a purchase order number, and want a manager to approve the bigger orders. The CrestApps Companies feature handles all of it in your Orchard Core store: an order limit for each buyer, a monthly budget, a required purchase order number, a deposit with the rest invoiced in net days, a credit limit, approval by a company admin, quotes, and punchout from the company's procurement system.

In this video:
• Why companies buy differently
• Setting the terms: order limit, deposit, net days, credit limit, budget, purchase order
• The buyer's checkout, and asking for approval
• The company admin approves or rejects
• Paying a deposit now and the rest on account
• What the company owes, and recording its payment
• Quotes with a purchase order, and punchout
• Use cases
